summary: Legacy checkbox visual, hidden from the node picker — superseded by net.noodl.controls.checkbox.
description: The original Checkbox visual, kept only so old projects load. The Checkbox control (net.noodl.controls.checkbox) supersedes it with visual states and accessibility.
whenToUse: Do not use in new graphs — use net.noodl.controls.checkbox instead.
runtimeBehavior: Its only dynamic ports are its Data Attributes list: each data-* name listed in `dataAttributes` becomes a string input of that name, written on the element (declared-port-groups). Every other port is static.
